size_basis: study registry box (params size_note); the duty sheet carries no size line and the fab study page envelope predates the node (WORK_ORDER W12)
holdup_basis: reported, no residence derived: the duty section 2 two-minute figure (0.2783 m3 at 200 t/d circulation) is not a designed volume (A-VES)

tank.wall_basis: study fab-page polymer wall (10 mm); no thickness booked on the node (WORK_ORDER W12)
tank.body: rectangular welded-plate tank, floor and walls inside the envelope, rim frame closes the top (HOPPER/FLOAT_SINK idiom)

internals.source: docs-authority/fab/ROOF_TANK.md (AQS-MFG-001 study page): dip pipe, stilling well; duty section 3: passive PVDF air coil

coil.area_basis: drawn area, NOT a calculated duty area: no authority sizes the coil (duty section 3; AQS-STD-002 section 10 Rev J records the trim superseded - conflict held, WORK_ORDER W12)

internals.basis: internals named by the issued study page and duty section 3; dimensions study values (WORK_ORDER W12); node internals row none, so the tracker records no internal solid

material.basis: duty section 3: PVC-U or HDPE per AQS-STD-002 rule M1; PVC-U drawn, the HDPE alternative is a named hold (WORK_ORDER W12); corrosion allowance does not apply to the polymer
